tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find live events on shapargullay (Pakistan): by words, city, category, when and price. Returns upcoming events soonest first with their page links for booking.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Everything about one event: description, every date with its ticket types and prices (PKR), venue, what is included, rules, FAQs, age limit and the booking link.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: The cities that have upcoming events on shapargullay, with how many.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories of upcoming events on shapargullay, with how many.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search shapargullay events by words (title, performer, city, category). Returns ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one shapargullay event by id (from search).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
